newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Communist China expected to announce approval of Taiwan applications for quasi-direct links.
Government to abolish tax exemption for interests earned from postal funds.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Financial industries to close on May 1, Taiwan's labour day.
Taiwan forms first Indigenous Defence Fighter air force wing.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan takes delivery of U.S.-made F-16 fighters.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan sets guidelines for Hong Kong workers in Taiwan following British colony's July 1 reversion to Beijing rule.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Economics minister says Taiwan investments in Chinese mainland can be "adjusted" if cross-straits relations improve.
